name: question-to-person
title: The agent passes a kitten's question to the person; their answer goes back down
about: Kitten 1 asks; the woken thread cannot answer and calls ask_person naming the kitten. The thread needs the person, ends on "Kitten 1 asks (via the agent)", the card says "Asks you (via the agent): …", and Needs you leads the item with the same words. The person answers in Needs you; the thread runs with their words, passes them to Kitten 1 with message_subagent ("The agent answered Kitten 1"), and the kitten resumes with them.

Kitten 1's card says the person has its question
